mainHTML:
Free · Playbooks & frameworks

Frameworks for creator-led growth.

Free AI frameworks and workflows for influencer marketing teams. Drawn from running 500+ campaigns across consumer brands.

  • AI Tools

    Content Analysis Framework

    Use Claude Skills and Gemini to analyse your best-performing influencer content in under an hour. Includes skill files, prompt templates, and a full how-to guide.

  • Strategy

    The Creator Discovery Guide

    Find the 3–5 creators who drive 80% of revenue. A data-backed guide to creator selection, tiering, and management — based on 10,000+ creator seedings.

  • Paid Media

    Creator Partnership Ads Playbook

    The complete guide to running creator-led ads on Meta. Covering creator selection, briefing, pricing, performance reporting, and timelines — with a Bloom & Wild case study.

  • Seeding

    The Seeding → Affiliate Playbook

    How to build a creator programme that pays for itself — from gifting to affiliates to whitelisted ads. Includes the break-even formula, posting rate benchmarks, and the seeding → affiliate → whitelist pyramid.

  • Paid Media

    The Rebriefing Playbook

    How to turn your best organic creators into a high-converting paid ads engine — without cold outreach, guesswork, or wasted spend. Covers warm rebriefing, the seeding-to-paid flow, product type considerations, and scaling the programme.

Let's scale your creator programme.

The playbooks are a head start. Want us to run it? 30-minute intro, no slides — we'll tell you whether Tano fits.
